about: The Eden request battery (Engine v2 E25, #2794): 240 requests a first-time owner would type, written by an agent that knew nothing of the engine. Frozen: a change needs a pull request that says why. Classes, partners and the facts each must show: classes.json. How a result is judged: RUBRIC.md.
